description: AABB mesh analytic ray intersections, distances, normals and topology.

mutants.description: AABBMesh hit normals are a unit direction used by callers for inside/outside classification.

mutants.old:
std::sort(hits.begin(), hits.end(),
              [](const igl::Hit<float>& a, const igl::Hit<float>& b) { return a.t < b.t; });
mutants.new:
std::sort(hits.begin(), hits.end(),
              [](const igl::Hit<float>& a, const igl::Hit<float>& b) { return a.t > b.t; });
mutants.description: query_ray_hits promises distance order from source to mesh crossings.
Two triangles sharing a coplanar seam must not expose duplicate geometric crossings.
squared_distance returns the exact squared distance to the selected triangle.
The closest-point out parameter is part of the public query contract.
Face-neighbor topology is exposed alongside the acceleration structure.
A hit_result distance identifies the reported intersection position.
hit_result retains the supplied ray direction used to compute position and orientation.
hit_result retains the ray source for position reconstruction and diagnostics.
Every query_ray_hits result must carry the actual crossing distance used for its position.
